## DEMO-1 result

Implemented one-time, locally generated demo seeding with no UI changes.

### What was built

- **`demoImages.ts`** — draws four 1200×800 notebook-style pages (two note pages, two source pages) entirely on canvas. Each page produces independent original, display, and thumbnail Blobs with MIME, dimensions, byte size, and SHA-256 metadata. No external image, font, URL, or asset is used.
- **`demoCase.ts`** — builds the six-card demo graph:
  - 2 notes, 2 sources, 2 topics
  - 2 provenance strings: note 1 → source 1, note 2 → source 2
  - 3 association strings: note 1 → topic 1, note 2 → topic 1, note 1 → topic 2
  - derived readiness: ready, zero loose threads
  - topic 1 solved with 2 linked notes; topic 2 developing with 1
  - 12 attachment records, 3 per note/source
- **`seedDemoCase.ts`** — checks the install flag and case count before generating anything, writes case/cards/connections/attachments in one IndexedDB transaction, sets the flag even when skipped, and provides `removeDemoCase` with an `isDemo` guard and flag re-assertion.

### Invariants and failure evidence

- **Graph legality:** canonical pair keys, no self-links, no duplicate pairs, provenance only between a note and a source; tested through `assertConnectionInCase` and readiness derivation.
- **Atomic seed failure:** injected a duplicate attachment primary key so the final `bulkAdd` fails after the case, cards, and strings were staged. Observed rollback: all four tables at zero rows and the install flag still unset.
- **One-time behavior:** second seed returns `already-seeded`; existing user case returns `existing-cases`, marks the flag, and writes nothing.
- **Removal:** deleting the demo leaves user cases untouched, removes all demo rows/blobs, and a simulated reload does not reseed.
- **Backup round-trip:** a real `.ndcase` archive manifest carries `isDemo: true`; copy restore through `importCase` preserves the marker and the full 6/5/12 graph; re-export preserves it again.

### Validation

- `npm test -- tests/demo/seedDemoCase.test.ts tests/demo/demoCase.test.ts tests/demo/demoBackup.test.ts` — **17 passed**
- `npm run typecheck` — **exit 0**
- Full suite — **945 passed, 75 files**
- `npm run lint` — 0 errors (3 pre-existing `RecallSummary.tsx` fast-refresh warnings)
- Prettier — clean
- Coverage: demo modules **88.3% lines**; unchanged `src/domain` **98.43% lines**, `src/data` **90.79% lines**

### Files created

- `src/features/demo/demoImages.ts`
- `src/features/demo/demoCase.ts`
- `src/features/demo/seedDemoCase.ts`
- `tests/demo/seedDemoCase.test.ts`
- `tests/demo/demoCase.test.ts`
- `tests/demo/demoBackup.test.ts`
- `tests/demo/demoFixtures.ts` (shared canvas/storage test helper)

### Files changed

No existing production files changed. The pre-existing modifications to `docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl` and `docs/WORKFLOW-STATE.json` were left untouched.

### Handoff notes

- **DEMO-3:** use `createDemoSeedFlagStore()`/`seedDemoCase()` and render the `isDemo` ribbon. Reuse one `DemoSeedFlagStore` per bootstrap. In jsdom component tests, inject `createCanvas` because jsdom has no 2D canvas implementation.
- `removeDemoCase()` refuses non-demo cases; the normal confirmed delete dialog can also be used because the seed flag is already durable.
- Demo source pages are 1200×800, below the existing display cap, so the display derivative has the same dimensions as the original; all three are separately encoded normal attachments.

handoff.summary: Implemented DEMO-1: locally canvas-generated demo pages, a close-ready six-card demo graph with five legal strings, atomic one-time seeding and demo-only removal, and isDemo preservation through real .ndcase export/import. The exact validation commands pass (17 demo tests; typecheck exit 0); full suite is 945 passing tests.
decisions: Install flag is notes-detective.demo.seeded in localStorage behind an injectable store; the flag is set when seeding succeeds and when it is skipped for existing cases.
Seed image generation happens only after the flag and zero-case checks; a failed generation or transaction leaves the flag unset so a later clean boot can retry.
The case, six cards, five strings, and twelve attachments commit in one read-write Dexie transaction, with attachments last so a failed Blob write rolls back the whole graph.
removeDemoCase rejects non-demo cases with DomainValidationError and re-marks the flag after a successful delete; generic confirmed delete remains safe because the seed flag is already durable.
The demo is left ready-to-close rather than closed; the five specified strings derive topic 1 as solved (2 notes) and topic 2 as developing (1 note).
